submission.justification: Module-D3 gives the highest light yield (55.8 PE/MeV at 30%), but 30% of modules failed after 20 thermal cycles, far above the 5% hard limit, and failed modules cannot be replaced, so it is excluded. Among the remaining designs, Module-D2 gives the highest light yield (37.7 PE/MeV at 30% coverage, versus 23.5 for Module-D1) with a 2% thermal-cycling failure rate, within the 5% limit. Coverage is set to 30%, the maximum allowed, which the meeting notes say the feedthroughs support. Light yield rises with coverage, so 30% is the best within the constraints.

requirements.requirement: Module must be one of the three candidate designs
requirements.evidence: Module-D2 (wavelength-shifting bar with SiPM readout) from candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: At most 5% of modules fail after 20 thermal cycles (hard)

requirements.evidence: Simulated Module-D2 at 30%: 37.7 PE/MeV, higher than D1 (23.5) at 30%. D3 is higher (55.8) but excluded by the failure constraint, so D2 is the best compliant option
